text:
这份 14 页中文路演 PPT 刚把字体从 MiSans 换成「微软雅黑」（Windows/WPS 必带，解决用户端乱码），文字宽度会略有变化。请做一次完整逐页视觉验收，标准：能直接上台讲。

PNG（150dpi，同一目录）：
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-01.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-02.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-03.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-04.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-05.png

重点：换字体后是否出现新的换行/溢出/压线/孤字；设备截图边框比例；深色页对比度；整篇一致性。每页一行 JSON：{"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":["具体到元素和位置"],"fix":"一句可执行修法"}。最后一句总体判断。

thinking:
I'm the visual acceptance reviewer for a 14-page Chinese roadshow PPT that was switched from MiSans to 微软雅黑 (Microsoft YaHei). I need to review each page image at /tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-01.png through slide-14.png.

Focus points from the dispatch:
- After font change: new line wraps/overflow/crowding against lines/orphan characters
- Device screenshot border aspect ratios
- Dark page contrast
- Overall consistency

Output format requested by dispatcher: one JSON line per page: {"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":["具体到元素和位置"],"fix":"一句可执行修法"}. Then a final overall judgment sentence.

Let me read the images one by one. I'll read them in batches perhaps. The instructions say read page images one by one, writing each page's verdict immediately after reading it. But I can batch independent reads. Let me read a few at a time to manage context. Actually the workflow says "Read your page images one by one, writing each page's verdict immediately after reading it." I can read them sequentially and note verdicts.

Let me start.

Page 1: Dark cover page. Title "Helm One" large white, subtitle white, top eyebrow text gray, bottom meta text. Device screenshot on right — a bike computer UI, aspect ratio looks like a portrait-ish device (looks like a bike GPS computer, roughly 4:3-ish landscape? Actually the screenshot is portrait-ish square). The device frame looks natural — like a Garmin/Wahoo style cycling computer which is landscape-oriented usually... Actually the image is taller than wide (portrait-ish). Hmm, cycling computers (码表) are typically landscape. But this could be a design choice. The screenshot appears to be a rendered device UI, border looks like rounded rect frame, ratio looks consistent with a 2.8"-ish screen portrait? Wahoo ELEMMA is landscape. But I shouldn't invent constraints. The screenshot content itself: gauge, bars, table — looks clean, no distortion. Labels readable.

Text: "一块为阳光、手套和没有信号的山里做的开源骑行码表" — two lines, wraps fine, no orphan single character? Line 2: "做的开源骑行码表" — that's fine, not an orphan.

Contrast: dark background with white text — good. Gray eyebrow "2026 首届 openvela AI 硬件开发者大赛 · 图形" — readable gray on dark. Bottom row "全开源 · Apache-2.0" and "独立开发 · 2026" — readable.

Caption under device: "P02 · 表盘页 20.5 km/h" fine.

Layout balanced: left text, right device. Pass.

Note the device screenshot frame: there's a subtle side button shape at left/right? I see small tabs on the sides. Looks fine.

Verdict: pass.

Next page.

Page 2: Light background, cream/off-white. Left column: three numbered items 01 反光, 02 手套, 03 没网 with body text. Right column: big statement "码表的第一性原理：抬头 0.5 秒，看清一个数。" with red accent. Text wraps cleanly, no orphan, no overflow. Line "是分辨率。" second line of item 01 — fine, two characters + period... "是分辨率。" is 5 chars, fine.

Bottom-right page number "02 / 14" in light gray on cream — small but that's a footer, fine.

Layout balanced. Pass.

Page 3: Spec table style — 4 rows with big numbers on left (2.4", 2 颗, 3 km, 2 核) and title+description. Device screenshot on right: portrait 240×320 screen in a dark frame with side buttons. Aspect ratio 240×320 = 3:4 portrait. The device frame looks portrait — consistent. The screenshot content looks clean; caption "P01 · 地图首页" and below "240×320 · 半透半反 · 无触摸".

Wait — the device frame: screen appears about 3:4, matching 240×320. Good.

The screenshot inner: status bar "22:12", map, time card, orange button "长按按钮 开始骑行". Clean.

Left rows: dividers, text fine. "蓝牙核跑协议，应用核跑界面； 144 / 240 MHz 两档。" fine.

Balance: right column has device + captions, and some empty space below but that's okay. Pass.

Page 4: Light. Left: three gray cards 感知/计算/呈现 connected by small vertical lines. Right: five list items with dividers. Text all fits, no overflow. The cards have some empty bottom space but they're consistent. Layout balanced. Page number 04/14. Pass.

Page 5: Architecture stack — 6 rows (APP, LINK, HELM highlighted green, BSP, OS dark, SoC). Right column stats: 19, 6, A2O. Text all fits on single lines, no overflow. The dark OS row has white text, good contrast. HELM row light green highlight. All clean. Pass.

Page 6: Three device screenshots (P05 仪表台, P03 全数字, P07 菜单) at portrait 240×320-ish aspect in dark frames, plus a status bar strip. Screenshots look clean and consistent aspect ratios. Third screenshot is cut off at the bottom (the device frame is cropped?) Actually looking at it: the three devices — third one "P07 菜单" shows the menu list and it's cut at bottom? The frame appears complete... Let me look again. The third device's bottom: "系统" section then a partially visible row "界面"? The screenshot content appears clipped mid-row at the bottom edge of the screen. That's within the screenshot itself — the screen content is cut off at bottom of the visible screen area? Hmm, the frame bottom appears cut off compared to devices 1 and 2 — devices 1 and 2 have visible bottom bezel with rounded corners; device 3 seems to extend to same baseline... Actually all three devices have the same height and captions aligned below. Device 3's screen content shows partial row at bottom which suggests content scrolled/clipped — that's how a menu looks when cropped, could be a deliberate crop to fit. Is it "destructive cropping"? The screenshot shows the device with its full frame? Looking at the image, device 3's frame appears to be missing its bottom bezel — the content runs to the bottom edge. Devices 1 and 2 clearly show bottom bezel (dark strip with rounded corner). Device 3: the content "界面" partial row extends to what appears to be the bottom edge without a bezel. Hmm, hard to be 100% sure. Let me zoom to verify.

Also right column text items — clean, no overflow. "LVGL 9.5 + EPIC GPU；双 SRAM 条带 + LCDC DMA 局部刷新" fits on one line.

Let me crop and inspect device 3 bottom edge vs device 1 bottom edge.

text: 第 6 页的三个设备截图需要仔细观察第三个的底部边缘。我来放大检查一下。

input:
{"command": "cd /tmp && python3 -c "
from PIL import Image
img = Image.open('/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-06.png')
print(img.size)
# crop bottom area of the three device screenshots
# devices occupy roughly x 100-950, y 230-620 in a 2000x1125-ish image
w,h = img.size
sc = w/2000.0
box = (int(90*sc), int(520*sc), int(980*sc), int(650*sc))
img.crop(box).resize((int((box[2]-box[0])*1.6), int((box[3]-box[1])*1.6)), Image.LANCZOS).save('/tmp/crop_p6_bottom.png')
"
", "description": "Crop bottom edge of device screenshots on slide 6"}

thinking:
All three devices have the same bottom bezel and rounded corners — the third device's screen content just scrolls (a menu list partially visible at the bottom of the screen, which is normal for a scrolled menu UI, and the bezel is intact). So no destructive cropping; the frame ratio is consistent across the three devices. Captions aligned.

Device 3 content: "系统" header then partially visible row "界面" — that's inside the screenshot, it's how the actual screen renders (menu list continues below fold). Acceptable.

Page 6: pass.

text:
已确认——所有三个设备边框都有相同的底部边框；第三个截图只是显示了一个滚动的菜单列表。第 6 页通过。

{"page":6,"verdict":"pass","issues":[],"fix":"无"}

thinking:
Page 7: Performance bars. Four metrics with before/after bars and red percentage changes.

Check bar proportionality: bars appear to be normalized to each row's "before" (改前) value — i.e., each bar shows before as full-ish, after as a fraction. Row 1: 27.2→21.9 = 80.5% — filled portion ~80%? The dark bar is ~80% of the track. Row 2: 61→43.7 = 71.6% — filled ~72%. Row 3: 2.88→1.94 = 67% — filled ~67%. Row 4: 195→17 = 8.7% — filled ~9%. Yes, consistent: dark fill = after/before ratio, track = before. The footer even says "相对值为各项自身改前归一" (relative values normalized to each item's own before). Good, matches claim.

Wait, row 4 dark fill is green while rows 1-3 are black/dark navy? Row 4 fill looks dark green. Hmm, could be intentional highlight (biggest win -91%)? Rows 1-3 look near-black; row 4 looks green-ish. Let me zoom to check colors. If it's a deliberate accent, fine; if inconsistent, could flag. Let me check pixel colors.

text: 条形比例与声明的归一化一致。我来检查一下第四个条形的填充颜色，它看起来是绿色，而其他的是深色。

input:

sc = w/2000.0
# sample fill colors of the 4 bars (left part of each dark fill)
for name,y in [('bar1',341),('bar2',491),('bar3',645),('bar4',799)]:

", "description": "Sample fill pixel colors of the four bars on slide 7"}

thinking: Hmm, my sample x may have missed the fill for bar4 since its fill is short (starts at x~535 and ends ~595?). Looking at the slide: row 4's dark-green fill starts at the same left edge (~x 535 in 2000px coords) and is short (~60px wide in the displayed 2000px image... actually the fill looks like from 535 to ~595). My sample at x=620 hit the track (216,213,203 = light gray). Let me sample at x=560.

w,h = img.size

for x in [540,555,570,585]:
    print(x, img.getpixel((int(x*sc), int(799*sc))))

thinking:
Bar 4 fill is (29,90,70) — dark green. Bars 1-3 are (21,26,23) — near-black. This is a deliberate accent for the standout -91% improvement, presumably. Is that a defect? Given the deck's palette includes dark green (HELM row highlight on slide 5 was light green; page 6 screenshot has green accents; the deck uses green as accent color). A single green bar highlighting the biggest win is a plausible design choice. "Stylized treatments are design choices, not defects." It could also read as inconsistency. Given the deck consistently uses red for deltas and dark for fills, one green fill draws attention to the -91% — I'll treat it as an intentional emphasis, not a defect. It's not confusing.

Layout: rows evenly spaced, no overflow, footnote and sources present, readable. Pass.

text:
第 4 个条形的填充是深绿色（29,90,70），而其他的接近黑色——这与演示文稿的强调色板保持一致，并突出了 −91% 的出色表现；这是刻意的设计。通过。

{"page":7,"verdict":"pass","issues":[],"fix":"无"}

thinking:
Page 8: Left: a map screenshot labeled "P04 · 地图页局部：真机矢量底图". The map crop: it's a device screen crop (status bar at top, "22:12"), 240×320 device. The crop shows the screen area. Aspect: the crop appears roughly square-ish (x~105-780, y~280-940 in 2000×1125) → 675 wide × 660 tall — approx 240×320 would be 0.75 ratio; this crop looks close to 1:1. It's labeled "局部" (partial crop) — a deliberate crop of the map page. The caption says 局部 so cropping is declared. The "200m" scale bar and "蜀" character at right edge partially clipped, "通用" and "攀洼路" clipped at bottom — but it's declared a 局部 (partial) crop, so edge clipping is inherent and acceptable.

Hmm wait, does the crop preserve the native aspect ratio (no stretch)? A 240×320 screen cropped to a partial region — the crop region's aspect is whatever region they took, that's fine as long as not stretched. Map streets look normal, circles are round. No stretch evident.

Right: 4 stat rows with dividers, clean. Bottom note lines fit. Pass.

Page 9: Five-step flow with numbered circles, step 4 highlighted red. Text under each step wraps in 2 lines, no orphans, no overflow. Large empty band between the step text and the bottom takeaway block (y ~560-800 empty). Is that a balance problem? The middle area has whitespace but the composition reads as: title, flow row, divider, takeaway. The whitespace gap is largish but symmetric — deliberate breathing room. At presentation distance it reads fine. Steps evenly spaced. Connector line spans between circles.

Verdict: pass.

Page 10: Left: big "144 / 240" stat, four state chips (骑行 dark, 静止, 熄屏, 关机 light). Right: five rows 调频/按键/背光/定位/蓝牙 with dividers. All single lines, no overflow. Contrast fine. Consistent with earlier pages. Pass.

Page 11: Dark page. Big red "0" on left with "次看门狗复位" and "单次开机 31,965 s（8.9 h）". Right: three sections with dividers. White on dark — good contrast. Body gray text on dark readable. Footnote bottom in dark gray — readable-ish, it's a footnote so fine. "0" is red on dark — fine. Title white bold.

One thing: on dark page, the eyebrow "10 — 可靠性" gray — readable.

Check contrast of footnote: "31,965 s 单 boot：clip 0 / stop feed 0 / DVFS 恢复 0 / BT RX 停顿 0。来源：docs/watchdog_irq_priority.md" — it's dim gray on near-black but legible in the render. Acceptable for a footnote. Pass.
Page 12: Five stat columns, then two columns 开源/可复现 with 3 lines each. Clean, no overflow, evenly spaced. Bottom whitespace is fine. Pass.
Page 13: Left statement, right 5 numbered rows 01-05 with dividers. All single lines, clean. Pass.

Page 14: Dark closing page. Big white statement, meta line, divider, "90 秒现场" + flow, footer line. Right: device screenshot showing boot screen (Helm One logo, progress bar), caption "Helm One · 开机启动". Device frame ratio portrait, consistent with pages 1/3/6. Screenshot clean.

Contrast: white on dark good; "90 秒现场" gray on dark — dimmer but legible; footer gray legible.

Cross-deck consistency: page numbers 02/14..14/14 present on content pages; cover has no number (fine). Palette consistent (cream light pages, two dark pages 1 and 11, 14 — 3 dark pages actually: 1, 11, 14; consistent with cover/closing/impact accents). Eyebrow style consistent. No font-induced overflow or orphan lines found anywhere. Device screenshots consistent aspect ratios across pages 1, 3, 6, 14.

Page 14: pass.

All 14 pages pass. Output the JSON lines. The dispatch asked format {"page":N,"verdict":"...","issues":["..."],"fix":"..."}. I've been outputting with "issues":[] and "fix":"无" for passes, which matches the requested schema. Then a final overall judgment sentence.
